text: DP World's ultimate owner is the Government of Dubai, whose federation, the UAE, sentenced 43 activists and dissidents to life imprisonment in a 2024 mass trial that rights groups called grossly unfair; the Federal Supreme Court upheld the convictions in March 2025.
short: Government of Dubai owns DP World; UAE mass-trial life sentences upheld in 2025

source.name: DP World Annual Report 2025 (ownership) + Human Rights Watch (mass trial and upheld convictions)
source.note: Ownership from DP World Limited's FY2025 annual report (dp-world-ownership claim in normalized/claims.json); mass-trial facts from HRW.
